notes: The marginal alternative *after the order of the king, even Asaph etc.* was read and set aside; the printed text governs (rule 38).

`עֲבֹדַת בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִים` is the multi-level fronting case of rule 29, exactly as `אֹצְרוֹת בֵּית הָאֱלֹהִים` → *the treasuries of the house of God*: the outer construct takes the supplied *the*, the article's *the* stands before *house*, and the innermost rectum keeps its own *of God*.
`בֵּית יְהוָה` carries no preposition morpheme, so the supplied *in* states what the bare nominal contributes and belongs to it under rule 33.
The waw before *Jeduthun* is `unrepresented`, the ASV writing no connective there (rule 14).
